blind.description: A neat stack of planed wooden planks arranged 3 wide and 4 high (12 boards in total). The boards are separated vertically by small wooden spacer pegs and rest on two perpendicular darker wooden runner blocks at either end. The model has clean, solid geometric shapes with stylized warm light brown wood texturing and slightly darker brown support blocks, free of mesh defects, floating elements, or holes.
blind.from_above: Three parallel, elongated rectangular wooden planks running vertically with small gaps between them, showing small darker wooden tabs protruding slightly at the sides near the top and bottom ends.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 40% of the figure's height (around 2.3 feet tall) and about 75% of the figure's height in length (around 4.3 feet long).

notes: Height is taller than catalog target (3.4 ft vs 1.8 ft), but reads clearly as a neat stack of lumber
